Messages.Author: Raven
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Walk of Caine

Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control who belong to the same circle as this acting vampire (including this acting vampire). Each chosen vampire must burn a blood, or this card has no effect.

g Only usable as a bleed action is announced. Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control of the same circle as this Blood Brother, including this Blood Brother. Each chosen Blood Brother burns 1 blood to give this Blood Brother +X bleed (limited).

G As g above, but usable any time before the action is resolved.

In order to play this card I must choose X vampires and burn 1 blood from each of them to get any effect (bold text).

Then I choose (for example) inferior effect. Must I again choose X vampires and again burn 1 blood from each of them or this cost is already satisfied during resolve of bold text?

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Does the card really need to be written like it is?
Why does the "Choose X..." need to be there twice?

Would the below not work exactly the same but without causing confusion?
(removed the second "Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control of the same circle as this Blood Brother, including this Blood Brother. Each chosen Blood Brother burns 1 blood to give this Blood Brother")

> Name: Walk of Caine
> Cardtype: Action Modifier
> Discipline: Sanguinus
> Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control who belong to the same circle as this acting vampire (including this acting vampire). Each chosen vampire must burn a blood, or this card has no effect.
> {Only usable as a bleed action is announced. +X bleed (limited).}
> As  above, but usable any time before the action is resolved.
>
Walk of Caine

Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Sanguinus
Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control who belong to the same circle as this acting vampire (including this acting vampire). Each chosen vampire must burn a blood, or this card has no effect.
{Only usable as a bleed action is announced. Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control of the same circle as this Blood Brother, including this Blood Brother. Each chosen Blood Brother burns 1 blood to give this Blood Brother +X bleed (limited).}
As  above, but usable any time before the action is resolved.

Messages.Author: emime
Messages.Body:
Unrelated, but even the [san] effect as newly worded could be misinterpreted, no?

Although ludicrous, "Each chosen Blood Brother burns 1 blood to give this Blood Brother +X bleed" could also be interpreted to mean that each BB burning a blood gives +X bleed to the acting BB, so that the total would be +X^2 bleed!

Maybe the original text was better in the end...

Emiliano "Sans Terre" - Wandering Player - Prince of Brussels
